ccv-peoria-az.assessment: CCV is one of the largest churches in America (~35,000 attendance) with a classic seeker-sensitive multisite model. Under Ashley Wooldridge it continues the practical, topical preaching approach. The church does genuine community good and has a missions heart, but the seeker model inherently softens doctrinal edges. At 35,000+ attendance across 10+ campuses, accountability is structurally challenging. YELLOW — impressive scale but needs verification on gender theology, expository commitment, and cultural backbone.

score_notes.christology: Christ is preached. Orthodox on the person of Christ.
score_notes.scripture: Statement of faith affirms Bible as God's Word. But seeker-sensitive model softens application.

score_notes.leadership: Large multisite (35,000+ attendance). Accountability at that scale is always a concern. Video-venue model.
score_notes.soteriology: Gospel presented but verify depth of repentance/lordship language in seeker-friendly context.
score_notes.cultural: Arizona megachurch — culturally conservative area but seeker models tend to avoid controversy.
score_notes.preaching: Topical/practical. High production value. Not expository.
score_notes.mission: Strong community impact and global missions program. One of the largest churches in America.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men's groups exist but verify depth and biblical masculinity emphasis.
score_notes.denominational: Independent non-denominational megachurch (35,000+ attendance) with no confessional accountability and no elder plurality surfaced on public pages; site 403s on /about and /who-we-are — opacity at this scale is itself an accountability concern. No network affiliation (9Marks/Acts 29/TGC/Founders/SG/G3/Master's). RED confirmed.
